Luxury homes, actual castles, and a property twice the size of Manhattan. Some people need to calm down.

I've gathered five of my luxury property videos into one compilation so we can spend some quality time looking at houses with considerably too much house.

We're looking at luxury homes in Hawaii, California and Nashville, making fun of some castles, and considering whether one property really needs to be twice the size of Manhattan. I feel like once your property requires a geography lesson, things have gotten out of hand.
